versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of MiniMax TTS skill.
- Provides high-quality text-to-speech synthesis for 40+ languages and 200+ voices via REST API.
- Supports streaming and non-streaming modes, multiple output formats (mp3, wav, pcm), and voice effects.
- Includes usage scripts, model and voice documentation, and support for sound tags and expressive voices.
- Example commands and full script options available in documentation.
